subtitle: Two-bench cedar build, includes delivery + setup

name: Cedar Sauna Kit — 4-6 Person
subtitle: Wide-bench cedar build, includes delivery + setup
description: Four- to six-person cedar sauna kit. Roomy two-tier benching, upgraded heater package sized to volume, glass door, and integrated lighting. name: Cedar Sauna Kit — 6-8 Person
subtitle: Top-of-line cedar sauna, includes delivery + setup
description: Six- to eight-person cedar sauna kit — the largest configuration. Wraparound benching, upgraded heater sized for the volume, glass door, integrated lighting, and optional changing nook.
